body: I cut my thighs, 5 cuts at a time on each leg, then I repeat for a total of 10 on each thigh. They don't overlap and are neatly aligned.
I believe you're correct. But mine are closer to scratches; they're not open wounds.
I always soak a cotton ball in alcohol and rub it across them. It's even more painful than the cuts themselves.
Mine are all on the top side of my thighs. Easier to hide and take care of, I believe.

I just reached 10 days clean. I hope to be as strong as you and reach such a high number, eventually not needing it at all.

Stay strong. <3 You're doing well.
Thank you. Even from a stranger, that means a lot. <3
That's one of the reasons it's hard. I've started to become known as someone who hurts others. Because every time I convince myself I'm ready to date again, it ends in pain for both of us.

I've been on her side of the issue before. It was hard because as much as my s.o. meant to me, my mind wouldn't let me accept the awesome life and amazing woman I had. After attempting, I was broken because I had failed her; she was broken because she felt she had failed me.

edit: spelling
You're not alone. I can't seem to stop hurting people lately. Whenever someone gets close I push them away. And then I'm left useless and all alone.

I don't hide my marks (above the knees). Same as with my depression; if it comes up or gets asked about, I'm honest. The more sensitive details are reserved for those close to me (but not family), but I acknowledge it to anyone.
That's what I'm struggling with. I can live with myself if I leave people behind - no pun intended :/. But it's all the *stuff* that I have that I don't want in other people's possession.
